test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states was the largest producer of Bauxite in 2018-19 as per the Indian Minerals Yearbook 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Odisha** comes out as the leading producing state accounting for about 65% of the total production throughout 2018-19 (Tables -2 to 5). Mine-head closing stocks of **bauxite in 2018-19 were 19,658 thousand tonnes as a contrast to 18,072 thousand tonnes in the foregoing year.**** **
 
• The chief bauxite belt is in **Kalahandi and Koraput **districts and expands further into** Andhra Pradesh.** 
 
• Bauxite is a **sedimentary rock** with a fairly high **aluminium content. **
 
• **It is the world's chief origin of aluminium and gallium. **

 [IMAGE: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/04/BauxiteUSGOV.jpg/220px-BauxiteUSGOV.jpg] 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Gujarat is the big maker of major cash crop like cotton, groundnut, tobacco, cumin, sesamum, etc. in India.
 
• Rajasthan is the big maker of rapeseed, bajra, mustard and wool in India and the second big maker of oilseeds and spices and milk.
 
• Madhya Pradesh is the big maker of pulses.it accounts for 22.4% of total manufacture in the country.​
